claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.focus_points
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature costs 3 Focus Points from the monk's shared pool, not a bonus action or free activation. ClassFeatureActivationCost has no variant for expending a named class resource.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 3 Focus Points to bolster yourself

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.grant_resistance
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants Resistance to all damage types except Force. The v4 atom grant_resistance exists in the taxonomy but is absent from the ClassFeatureEffect union — only GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect are present.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Resistance to all damage except Force damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics.duration
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature has a timed duration (1 minute). ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has no duration field at all; Duration is only present on SpellMechanicsHeader.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration.timed_or_condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature ends either when the timed duration expires OR when the Incapacitated condition is applied. The existing Duration union (instantaneous / concentration / timed) has no condition-triggered cancellation path.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition.incapacitated
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The break condition references the Incapacitated condition. The Condition type currently only contains 'prone' (from Topple mastery). Incapacitated must be added.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: until you have the Incapacitated condition

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics.activationWindow
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Activation is restricted to 'at the start of your turn'. The v4 atom turn_start_window exists but class-feature mechanics have no timing/window field to express when the feature may be invoked.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the start of your turn, you can expend 3 Focus Points

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountResource or new external_pool_resource
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature draws from the monk's shared Focus Point pool (a class-level resource shared across many features), not an independent use_count owned by this feature. The current resource model has no way to reference an external named pool.
